itemDisplayName: Deploy a 3 Node 1 Nodetype Windows Service Fabric Cluster with standard load balancer, NSG, and Automatic OS Upgrade with Existing Vnet configuration
description: This template allows you to deploy a secure 3 node Service Fabric Cluster running Windows Server 2022 Datacenter on a Standard_DS4_v2 Size VMSS. The cluster will be deployed into an existing virtual network and subnet. Bronze clusters are considered development clusters and should not be used in production.
summary: This template takes a minimum amount of parameters and deploys 3 Node Service Fabric Cluster running windows
